bead.title: Add hybrid async backpressure and poison controls
bead.description: Add bounded-debt metrics, backpressure, and poison/fail-closed behavior. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs, crates/pqueue-server/src/env_config.rs, crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs, tests. Expose lag commands/bytes/time, checkpoint queue depth, WAL size where available, memory growth/debt, backpressure count/duration, checkpoint errors. Reject or pause mutations when thresholds are exceeded before recovery SLOs are violated. Persistent checkpoint errors, corruption, or unresolved replay poison must stop serving; high-water must not advance past poison. Out of scope: performance matrix evidence.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-server env_config hybrid_async -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_async_backpressure -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-engine poison -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
